When u are dissapointed watching others go anywhere but where they need to, little changes that shows they are starting to wake will make u so hopeful en satisfied as if they have archived all theire goals in life, its funny in a way

---

You already know what you want, freedom, leaning and spiritual growth. 

Reason you cant complete things likely is part that seeks freedom overpowers intent to keep on etc. 

You just have to find a way to make money while u dont sacrifices who u are or atleast not too much, that because few years down the line if u force u will just endup quiting en starting anew. 

Is too bad that we born in a world that put money above people and their interests,  so dont blame you blame that the world is not perfect for you.

As for your mother she wont abandoned you not entirely she just exhausted watching you getting no where while years go by, so go refix ur relationship,  paying her back is fine goal but u dont have to wait, start by making her a coup of tea evry morning en subtract a penny from what u owe her , those little things en you showing u are serious about getting somehwere counts more
